g.text: Anti-alias filtering must limit analog bandwidth before sampling

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned sampling example; left is a pre-filter spectrum and right demonstrates the consequence of an inadequate filter, not the correctly filtered
outcome. Proper analog attenuation removes out-of-band content before sampling. Reconstruction cannot distinguish the700 Hz source from its300 Hz alias
after acquisition. Ideal code width excludes noise and converter errors.
